AK.name: Alaska
AK.localNote: Uses boroughs instead of counties. Nearly half the state is an unorganized borough run by the state.
AK.preregistrationNote: May register within 90 days before turning 18.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes name, address, and party. Birth date, ID numbers, and signature are withheld.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

AL.name: Alabama
AL.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Parties get the state list and legislators their district list. Others may buy it. Includes 10 elections of voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Electioneering, campaign, or election purposes. Not for sale, publication, or commercial use.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Includes name, address, and precinct.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Given to political parties. Also open for local public inspection. Includes name, address, phone, birth year, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Political, campaign, election, or redistricting purposes. Not commercial. No posting online.

voterList.publicFields: Available to candidates, parties, ballot measure committees, and others with an allowed purpose.
voterList.allowedUse: Election, scholarly, journalistic, political, or government purposes. Not commercial. No harassment or reposting.

CO.name: Colorado

testimony.how: Register on the public testimony website for a scheduled bill, then testify in person, by Zoom, or in writing.

CO.preregistrationNote: Age 15 since January 1, 2025; it was 16 before.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone on request. Includes name, address, birth year, party, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.localNote: Counties have no government. Towns and cities provide local government.
CT.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open for public inspection. Copies are available from town registrars.
voterList.allowedUse: Election, scholarly, journalistic, political, or government purposes. Not personal or commercial.

DC.name: District of Columbia
DC.legislature: Council of the District of Columbia
DC.localNote: DC is a federal district, not a state. It has no counties.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone on request. Includes party, ward, precinct, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

voterList.publicFields: Free to parties, candidates, and governments. Others may buy it. Includes name, address, party, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes public voter data. ID numbers, signatures, and preregistrant data are withheld.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes birth year and other non-confidential data.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

HI.name: Hawaii

testimony.how: Submit written testimony, including through the online testimony feature, or testify orally at a scheduled hearing.

HI.localNote: There are no separate city governments. The counties are the local governments.

voterList.publicFields: Name, address, district or precinct, and voter status are public. Other data is confidential.
voterList.allowedUse: Other data only for election or government purposes.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone who pays the cost. The buyer chooses fields.
voterList.allowedUse: Voting-related, political, official, or political research purposes. Not commercial.

ID.name: Idaho

testimony.how: Where a committee allows it, sign up ahead on the committee page's public testimony registration tab to testify remotely.

ID.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes name, address, and precinct.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

voterList.publicFields: Sold to state political committees and governments. The public may view it on screen only.
voterList.allowedUse: Not commercial. Public viewers may not print, copy, or alter it.

IN.name: Indiana
IN.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Only to parties, independent candidates, media, courts for juries, and legislative leaders.
voterList.allowedUse: Political activities only. Not commercial.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Anyone may inspect it or request a copy. ID numbers are removed.
voterList.allowedUse: Not commercial. Campaign and election use is allowed.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Citizens may inspect and copy records. Precinct lists go to candidates and committees at cost.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

voterList.publicFields: Open for local inspection. A group of 25 or more voters may request a copy.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.localNote: Most counties no longer have governments. Cities and towns provide most local government.

voterList.publicFields: Given to parties, statewide candidates and committees, and certain officials. Includes names and addresses.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

MD.name: Maryland

testimony.how: Create an MGA account, then sign up to testify in person or by Zoom, or upload written testimony as a PDF.

MD.localNote: Baltimore is an independent city, not part of any county.

voterList.publicFields: Available to Maryland registered voters. Requesters choose fields such as name, address, party, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No further use limits stated in the source.

ME.name: Maine
ME.localNote: Towns and cities hold most local authority.

voterList.publicFields: Only to parties, get-out-the-vote groups, officeholders, governments, and law enforcement.
voterList.allowedUse: Party, get-out-the-vote, or campaign purposes.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes name, address, and birth year.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

testimony.how: Arrange testimony with committee staff before a scheduled hearing.

voterList.publicFields: Any Minnesota registered voter may get a copy. Includes name, address, birth year, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Elections, political activities, or law enforcement only.

MO.name: Missouri
MO.localNote: St. Louis is an independent city, not part of any county.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Includes name, birth date, address, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone under the public records law. Includes name, address, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

MT.name: Montana

testimony.how: Use the Public Participation app to sign up for remote testimony or submit written comments on a bill.

MT.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Fields can be chosen.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes name, address, sex, race, age, party, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

ND.name: North Dakota

testimony.how: Register through Zoom Webinar to submit written or oral testimony for a scheduled committee hearing.

ND.preregistrationNote: No voter registration. Voters must be 18 on Election Day.

voterList.publicFields: North Dakota has no voter registration. Its central voter file goes to candidates, parties, and committees.
voterList.allowedUse: Election-related purposes only.

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Includes address, birth year, party, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Elections, political activity, voter registration, law enforcement, or jury selection only.

NH.name: New Hampshire

testimony.how: Use the online form to register a position and submit testimony for a House committee hearing.

NH.localNote: Towns and cities hold most local authority.
NH.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: One free copy to parties, committees, and candidates. Others may view it in person only.
voterList.allowedUse: Not commercial. Viewers may not print, copy, or alter it.

voterList.publicFields: Available to any voter for a fee. Free to parties.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

NM.name: New Mexico

testimony.how: For interim committees, join the committee's Zoom webinar and use the raise-hand feature when public comment opens.

NM.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available by written request.
voterList.allowedUse: Government, election, or campaign purposes only.

NV.name: Nevada
NV.localNote: Carson City is an independent city, not part of any county.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Free to political parties.
voterList.allowedUse: Must relate to an election. Not commercial.

voterList.publicFields: Open for public inspection. Copies may be bought. Includes name, address, and party.
voterList.allowedUse: Election purposes only.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open for public inspection. Includes name, address, precinct, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

voterList.publicFields: Available to residents, party representatives, candidates, and others allowed by law. Includes name, address, and party.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

testimony.how: Register in OLIS to testify in person or remotely, or submit written testimony online within 48 hours of the hearing.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Free to parties. Includes name, party, address, and phone.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open for inspection. Street lists go to parties and candidates. Registered voters may buy copies.
voterList.allowedUse: Election, political, or law enforcement purposes only. Not commercial.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.localNote: Counties have no government. Cities and towns provide local government.

voterList.publicFields: Given to candidates and parties. Includes name, party, address, and districts.
voterList.allowedUse: Political purposes or candidacy only.

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open for inspection. Any qualified South Carolina voter may request it.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

SD.name: South Dakota
SD.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open for public inspection at the county office.
voterList.allowedUse: Election purposes only. No sale, commercial use, or open posting online.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone who certifies political use, for a fee. Includes voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: Political purposes only.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone. Includes name, birth date, registration number, and address.
voterList.allowedUse: Not for commercial use.

testimony.how: Ask the committee's staff policy analyst in advance to be placed on the chair's list to testify.

voterList.publicFields: Only to qualified groups, such as governments, parties, and others who agree to confidentiality.
voterList.allowedUse: Birth month and year may be used only for political purposes.

VA.name: Virginia

testimony.how: For House committees, sign up online to speak, including virtually, or to submit written comments.

VA.localNote: All cities are independent and are not part of any county.

voterList.publicFields: Sold to candidates, parties, PACs, and officeholders. Also to groups promoting voter participation.
voterList.allowedUse: Campaign and political purposes, reports to constituents, and voter participation mailings.

VT.name: Vermont

testimony.how: Committees invite witnesses, who may testify by Zoom or send written testimony as a PDF to the committee assistant. This guide is from one committee.

VT.localNote: Towns and cities hold most local authority. Counties mainly serve as court and sheriff districts.
VT.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Town clerks give copies to party chairs and anyone else, at cost.
voterList.allowedUse: Not commercial. No public posting or database matching.

testimony.how: Sign in online to testify, submit written testimony, or record your position for a scheduled hearing.

voterList.publicFields: Available to any person through a public records request.
voterList.allowedUse: Political use allowed. Not commercial. Misuse is a felony.

WI.name: Wisconsin

testimony.how: Fill out a hearing slip or electronic registration form at the hearing, then testify or simply record your position.

WI.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Open to public inspection and electronic access. Includes name, address, and voting history.
voterList.allowedUse: No use limits stated in the source.

voterList.publicFields: Available to anyone for a fee. Includes name, address, party, and status.
voterList.allowedUse: Not commercial. No solicitation, advertising, or resale.

WY.name: Wyoming
WY.preregistrationNote: No preregistration age. You may register if you will be 18 by the next election.

voterList.publicFields: Only to candidates, parties, campaign committees, officials, PACs, and voter participation groups.
voterList.allowedUse: Political purposes only. Not commercial.
